{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "pablomartin4btc",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested doc/release note heading tweak and asked about description update"
    },
    {
      "login": "maflcko",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "reviewed commit structure regarding MAX_BIP125_RBF_SEQUENCE deprecation comment"
    },
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out deprecated arguments must throw when supplied without -deprecatedrpc=bip125, opposed unnecessary test rename"
    },
    {
      "login": "polespinasa",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; raised multiple review comments regarding missing test coverage for replaceable=False, commit atomicity, and release note categorization"
    },
    {
      "login": "w0xlt",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "noted help examples still included replaceable=true"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "pinged author for rebase"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:4638052097",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "deprecated options would be silently ignored when flag is not set instead of alerting user",
      "quote": "If a user does add a replaceable argument but does not enable the deprecated flag it will be ignored without the user noticing. I think all deprecated fields should throw if used when the deprecated flag is not set.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented error throwing when flag is missing",
      "author_replies": ["c:4903414497"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4903414497",
      "status_by_quote": "Done"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4639435825",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "mass renaming rbf_node to node in test breaks git blame unnecessarily",
      "quote": "seems entirely unnecessary. Mass renaming things in that file breaks git blame, and I don't really see the benefit for changing the name.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author dropped the rename commit",
      "author_replies": ["c:4903414497"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:4903414497",
      "status_by_quote": "Dropped"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3531816137",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "release notes entry used an invalid section header",
      "quote": "This is not a valid section header for release notes. This could either be a standalone Notable Change, in which case this section header should be a title that describes what the change, or it should",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author fixed the section header",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3536118558"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3536118558",
      "status_by_quote": "Fixed"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4911084104",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "RPC help examples would fail on default nodes because they include the deprecated argument",
      "quote": "On a node started without -deprecatedrpc=bip125 (the default), three sendtoaddress examples in this help block still supply the deprecated option.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated the RPC help examples",
      "author_replies": ["c:5266274590"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5266274590",
      "status_by_quote": "Applied the suggestion."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3766917493",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "FundTxDoc documents replaceable as deprecated across all spend RPCs before those RPCs actually implement the deprecation check",
      "quote": "This docs replaceable as deprecated for all RPC calls using FundTxDoc, but in this commit only sendall has the flag check and the error throw. For the other calls send, fundrawtransaction, walletcreat",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author merged the commits affecting the 4 RPCs to maintain commit atomicity",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4377493430"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4377493430",
      "status_by_quote": "Merged the two commits affecting the 4 RPCs."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3766996506",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "tests do not check replaceable=False for send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall, reducing test coverage while deprecated",
      "quote": "This is a bit a duplicated comment from others I left, but just to summarize, this is not covering the cases for Replaceable=False for send, sendtoaddress, sendmany and sendall",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added test coverage for replaceable=False",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4377495848"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4377495848",
      "status_by_quote": "Addressed."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3767037970",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "createpsbt and createrawtransaction are categorized under wallet RPCs in release notes when they are rawtransaction/node RPCs",
      "quote": "If I am not wrong, createpsbt, and createrawtransaction are not Wallet rpc",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author addressed the RPC categorization during rebase",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4376339450"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4376339450",
      "status_by_quote": "Addressed during rebase."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3766873055",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "testing bumpfee with replaceable=False was removed without being added elsewhere, reducing test coverage",
      "quote": "testing bumpfee with replaceable = False is removed and not added in any other place later. This removes test coverage.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added test coverage for replaceable=False in bumpfee",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4377492013"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4377492013",
      "status_by_quote": "Not that important to test this field in bumpfee but added coverage for it."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3766984246",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "ensure the test asserts the RPC error is actually enforced rather than only checking error fields if an exception happens to be thrown",
      "quote": "This tests feels wrong, it is not testing that the RPC error is enforced, only that, in case it fails, the error is the expected one.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added an assertion in the try block",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4377495343"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4377495343",
      "status_by_quote": "Added an assertion in the try block in case the exception is not thrown."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:4638052097",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "supports deprecating the replaceable RPC arguments",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": ["src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp", "test/functional/wallet_deprecated_rbf.py"]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author addressed all remaining comments from polespinasa regarding commit atomicity, replaceable=False test coverage, release note categorization, and test assertions, and rebased.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "re-review from polespinasa following author's updates and rebase",
      "id": "rc:4377496922"
    }
  ]
}
